{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''orphanage''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meastrinnar]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vondrel]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as part of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pacification of Meastrinnar|pacification campaign]] in Vondrel, a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] detachment under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Vin Northal/Legends|Vin Northal]] stormed the orphanage based on an incorrectly-decoded Imperial transmission informing of the discovery of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] cell in Vondrel's sister city, [[Vondrol]]. Assaulting the building under the cover of darkness, the stormtroopers [[Death/Legends|killed]] dozens of lifeforms inside, only for Northal to realize a few [[Standard second|seconds]] later that the supposed Rebel targets had instead been [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]]. The Empire subsequently covered up the true nature of the massacre, while the conflicted Northal himself soon defected to the Alliance.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
